output: html_document
params:
  data_dir: !r file.path(Sys.getenv("USERPROFILE", "~"), "Dropbox", "Effect SAE on SUA", "data",
    "finalized_design_v1", "composition")

  cores: 0

Tables and figures of the access section ("Centralized Assignment and Access to Over-Demanded Schools") and
its appendix: who enters the over-demanded schools before and after SAE's staggered rollout. Each estimate
is did's group-time average effect (Callaway and Sant'Anna 2021) with not-yet-treated comparison cells and
base period $g-1$. Standard errors come from did's multiplier bootstrap clustered by region; stars come from
a randomization test over saved reassignments of the rollout across the 16 regions. The notebook reads the
data folder (`data_dir`) and writes `tables/` and `figures/` in the output folder (`out_dir`).

```{r setup, error = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(data.table)
library(did)
library(parallel)
stopifnot(packageVersion("did") == "2.1.2")   # did's bootstrap standard errors depend on its version

# folders and cores: from `params` when given (rmarkdown::render, or a list named params defined before knitr::knit)
shared <- file.path(Sys.getenv("USERPROFILE", "~"), "Dropbox", "Effect SAE on SUA", "data")
opt <- list(data_dir = file.path(shared, "finalized_design_v1", "composition"), out_dir = "output", cores = 0)
if (exists("params")) opt[names(params)] <- params
DATA_DIR <- opt$data_dir
TAB_DIR <- file.path(opt$out_dir, "tables")
FIG_DIR <- file.path(opt$out_dir, "figures")
for (folder in c(TAB_DIR, FIG_DIR)) dir.create(folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

N_CORES <- if (opt$cores == 0) detectCores() else min(detectCores(), opt$cores)
setDTthreads(N_CORES)
cl <- makeCluster(N_CORES)   # the processes that score the saved reassignments

SEED_MAIN <- 20260815     # Table II, Appendix Table B.4, Figure 2's GPA panel
SEED_ROBUST <- 20260806   # Appendix Table B.3, rows 1-6
SEED_PRIO_ES <- 20260830  # Figure 2's low-income panel
SEED_PRIOR <- 20260915    # Appendix Table B.3, last row
SEED_NINTH <- 20261018    # Appendix Table B.5
SEED_COUNTS <- 20261018   # Appendix Table B.6
B_BOOT <- 10000           # bootstrap draws
B_BOOT_ROBUST <- 999      # bootstrap draws, Appendix Table B.3's rows 2-6
B_RI <- 9999              # saved reassignments of the rollout
B_RI_ROBUST <- 2999       # saved reassignments, robustness rows, placebo outcomes and entrant counts

outcomes <- c(gpa_z = "Prior-year GPA (SD)", sh_prio = "Low-income share")

fmt <- function(x, d = 3) sub("^-(0\\.0+)$", "\\1", sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f"), x))   # never "-0.000"
comma_int <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
star <- function(p) ifelse(p < .01, "$^{***}$", ifelse(p < .05, "$^{**}$", ifelse(p < .1, "$^{*}$", "")))
row_tex <- function(label, cells, end = " \\\\") paste0(label, " & ", paste(cells, collapse = " & "), end)
write_tex <- function(lines, file) writeLines(c("% Generated by composition.Rmd", lines), file.path(TAB_DIR, file))

# a whole table of the appendix: caption, column alignment, rows and note
tex_float <- function(caption, columns, body, note) c(
  "\\begin{table}[!htbp]", "\\singlespacing\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.2}", "\\centering", caption, "\\small",
  paste0("\\begin{tabular*}{\\textwidth}{@{\\extracolsep{\\fill}}", columns, "@{}}"), "\\toprule", body,
  "\\bottomrule", "\\end{tabular*}", "\\par\\smallskip", "\\begin{minipage}{\\textwidth}\\footnotesize",
  paste("Notes:", note), "\\end{minipage}", "\\end{table}")
star_note <- paste("Stars use the regional randomization test described in Appendix~\\ref{app: regional inference}:",
                   "$^{***}p<0.01$, $^{**}p<0.05$, $^{*}p<0.1$.")
```

# Data

```{r data}
# one row per entrant child-year in an over-demanded school-grade, 2012-2023
EP <- as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, "composition_panel.rds")))

# the cell-year panel: a cell is a school-grade
CP <- EP[, .(n_ent = .N, sh_prio = mean(PRIO), gpa_z = mean(PRIOR_GPA_Z, na.rm = TRUE),
             n_gpa = sum(!is.na(PRIOR_GPA_Z)), n_low = sum(PRIO)),
         by = .(yr = AGNO, rbd = RBD, cod_nivel = COD_NIVEL, door = DOOR, region = REGION, is_entry = IS_ENTRY,
                slack_fail = SLACK_FAIL)]
CP[cod_nivel < 2L, `:=`(gpa_z = NA_real_, n_gpa = 0L)]   # the GPA outcome covers entrants to grades 2-12
CP[, n_other := n_ent - n_low]
CP[, cell := paste(rbd, cod_nivel, sep = "|")]
CP[, cell_id := as.integer(factor(cell))]
CP[, G := door + 1L]                        # adoption year: the first class SAE assigns
CP[, w_ent := mean(n_ent), by = cell_id]    # weight of the entrant-weighted row

# the saved reassignments of the rollout: for each test, one named vector (region -> wave) per reassignment
files <- list.files(file.path(DATA_DIR, "draws", "did", "regional"), pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(files) == 16)
draws <- lapply(setNames(files, sub("\\.rds$", "", basename(files))), function(f) {
  a <- readRDS(f)$assignments
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(a)), function(b) a[b, ])
})
```

# Estimation and inference

```{r estimation-functions}
# did's effect of SAE on outcome y in the cell-year panel D. aggte follows att_gt at once: its bootstrap
# continues att_gt's draws
fit_cs <- function(D, y, type = "simple", bit = B_BOOT, w = NULL, ...) {
  fit <- att_gt(yname = y, tname = "yr", idname = "cell_id", gname = "G", data = D[!is.na(get(y))],
                control_group = "notyettreated", panel = TRUE, allow_unbalanced_panel = TRUE,
                base_period = "universal", weightsname = w, bstrap = TRUE, biters = bit, clustervars = "region",
                print_details = FALSE, ...)
  agg <- aggte(fit, type = type, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (type == "dynamic") return(data.table(e = agg$egt, att = agg$att.egt, se = agg$se.egt))
  list(att = agg$overall.att, se = agg$overall.se, n = nrow(fit$DIDparams$data))   # n: the cell-years did uses
}

# the outcome's mean over the cell-years before the cell's adoption year
pre_mean <- function(D, y) D[yr < G & !is.na(get(y)), mean(get(y))]

# each region's wave: the DOOR of its entry grades (its other grades follow a year later)
wave_map <- function(D) {
  W <- unique(D[, .(region, wave = door - (1L - is_entry))])[order(region)]
  setNames(W$wave, as.character(W$region))
}

# the outcome as a cell x year matrix, with each cell's region, entry-grade status and weight
prep_ri <- function(D, yvar, wcol = NULL) {
  id <- c("cell", "region", "is_entry", wcol)
  Wd <- dcast(D[!is.na(get(yvar))], as.formula(paste(paste(id, collapse = " + "), "~ yr")), value.var = yvar)
  yrs <- setdiff(names(Wd), id)
  list(M = as.matrix(Wd[, ..yrs]), region = Wd$region, is_entry = Wd$is_entry, yrs = as.integer(yrs),
       w = if (!is.null(wcol)) Wd[[wcol]])
}

# The parts of the paired estimate that stay the same under every rollout: for each adoption group g and
# year t >= g, the cells observed in t and in the base year g - 1 - antic, and their change between the two
prepare_jackknife <- function(pp, waves, antic = 0L) {
  groups <- sort(unique(as.vector(outer(unname(waves), 1L - unique(pp$is_entry), `+`)) + 1L))
  pairs <- unlist(lapply(groups, function(g) {
    bi <- match(g - 1L - antic, pp$yrs)
    if (is.na(bi)) return(list())
    lapply(pp$yrs[pp$yrs >= g], function(t) {
      ti <- match(t, pp$yrs)
      valid <- which(!is.na(pp$M[, ti]) & !is.na(pp$M[, bi]))
      list(g = g, t = t, rows = valid, difference = pp$M[valid, ti] - pp$M[valid, bi],
           region = pp$region[valid], weight = if (is.null(pp$w)) NULL else pp$w[valid])
    })
  }), recursive = FALSE)
  list(region_index = match(as.character(pp$region), names(waves)), is_entry = pp$is_entry, pairs = pairs,
       regions = sort(unique(pp$region)), antic = antic)
}

# The randomization statistic under a rollout `waves`. th: the paired estimate (each group-time effect is the
# treated cells' mean change less the not-yet-treated cells', weighted by the treated cells' count or weights).
# t: th over its delete-one-region jackknife SE
score_jackknife <- function(prepared, waves) {
  G <- unname(waves)[prepared$region_index] + 2L - prepared$is_entry
  numerator <- denominator <- numeric(length(prepared$regions) + 1L)
  for (pair in prepared$pairs) {
    group <- G[pair$rows]
    treated <- which(group == pair$g)
    control <- which(group > pair$t + prepared$antic)
    if (!length(treated) || !length(control)) next
    for (j in seq_along(numerator)) {   # j = 1: every region; j > 1: region j - 1 left out
      it <- treated; ic <- control
      if (j > 1L) {
        omit <- prepared$regions[j - 1L]
        it <- it[pair$region[it] != omit]
        ic <- ic[pair$region[ic] != omit]
      }
      if (!length(it) || !length(ic)) next
      if (is.null(pair$weight)) {
        att <- mean(pair$difference[it]) - mean(pair$difference[ic])
        weight <- length(it)
      } else {
        att <- weighted.mean(pair$difference[it], pair$weight[it]) -
          weighted.mean(pair$difference[ic], pair$weight[ic])
        weight <- sum(pair$weight[it])
      }
      numerator[j] <- numerator[j] + weight * att
      denominator[j] <- denominator[j] + weight
    }
  }
  estimates <- rep(NA_real_, length(numerator))
  valid <- denominator != 0
  estimates[valid] <- numerator[valid] / denominator[valid]
  loo <- estimates[-1L]
  ok <- !is.na(loo); Rp <- sum(ok)
  variance <- if (Rp >= 2L) (Rp - 1) / Rp * sum((loo[ok] - mean(loo[ok]))^2) else NA_real_
  c(th = estimates[1L], t = estimates[1L] / sqrt(variance))
}

# randomization p: the share of reassignments whose |t| is at least the observed |t|
ri_p <- function(t_obs, t_draws) (1 + sum(abs(t_draws) >= abs(t_obs))) / (1 + length(t_draws))

# The randomization test of one estimate: the observed statistic against the saved reassignments `key`, scored
# in parallel
ri_test <- function(D, yvar, key, wcol = NULL, antic = 0L) {
  stopifnot(length(draws[[key]]) > 0L)   # the saved reassignments of this test were read
  wv <- wave_map(D)
  prepared <- prepare_jackknife(prep_ri(D, yvar, wcol), wv, antic)
  obs <- score_jackknife(prepared, wv)
  TT <- vapply(parLapply(cl, draws[[key]], score_jackknife, prepared = prepared), `[[`, 0, "t")
  list(th = obs[["th"]], t = obs[["t"]], p = ri_p(obs[["t"]], TT[is.finite(TT)]))
}
```

# Table I and Appendix Tables B.1 and B.2: the over-demanded schools before SAE

The over-demanded schools against the other SAE schools with ninth-grade seats, each school counted once:
their 2012-2015 graduates' records and the schools' value added.

```{r table1}
SCHOOLS <- as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, "composition_schools.rds")))
catalogue <- SCHOOLS[IN_CATALOGUE == TRUE]

# value added is measured from the average school of each fit
VA_FITS <- c("HEAD", "REG", "NOGPA", "NOPAR", "SPL", "C13", "C15")
va_cols <- paste0("VA_", VA_FITS)
catalogue[, (va_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)), .SDcols = va_cols]

A_COLS <- c(NEM_PERCENTILE_MEAN = "Avg.\\ NEM (Percentile)",
            LM_PERCENTILE_MEAN  = "Avg.\\ Math--Language (Percentile)",
            VA_HEAD             = "School Value Add (SD)",
            ASSIGNED_ANY_MEAN   = "Any centralized assignment (\\%)",
            ASSIGNED_TOP10_MEAN = "Top-10\\% program assignment (\\%)",
            ASSIGNED_TOP25_MEAN = "Top-25\\% program assignment (\\%)",
            ASSIGNED_TOP50_MEAN = "Top-50\\% program assignment (\\%)")
common <- catalogue[IS_COMMON == TRUE]   # the schools with every measure of Table I
panel_a <- common[, c(lapply(.SD, mean), .(schools = .N)), keyby = GROUP, .SDcols = names(A_COLS)]
panel_a

# three decimals, a negative number in math mode
sd3 <- function(x, math = "$%s$") ifelse(startsWith(fmt(x), "-"), sprintf(math, fmt(x)), fmt(x))
records <- c("\\begin{tabular}{lrr}", "\\toprule", " & Over-demanded & Other SAE \\\\", "\\midrule",
             vapply(names(A_COLS), function(v) {
               row_tex(A_COLS[[v]], if (v == "VA_HEAD") sd3(panel_a[[v]]) else sprintf("%.1f", panel_a[[v]]))
             }, ""),
             "\\midrule", row_tex("Schools", comma_int(panel_a$schools)), "\\bottomrule", "\\end{tabular}")
write_tex(records, "lottery_od_historical_records.tex")
```

```{r table-b2}
# a group's mean value added under one fit; the SE of the mean is sigma_e * sqrt(sum(1 / students)) / schools
va_mean <- function(fit, min_students = 0) {
  v <- catalogue[, .(GROUP, va = get(paste0("VA_", fit)), students = get(paste0("VA_N_", fit)),
                     sigma = get(paste0("SIGMA_E_M_", fit)))]
  v[!is.na(va) & students >= min_students,
    .(mean = mean(va), se = sigma[1] * sqrt(sum(1 / students)) / .N, schools = .N, students = sum(students)),
    keyby = GROUP]
}
va_checks_list <- list(
  "Main estimate"                          = va_mean("HEAD"),
  "Eighth-grade GPA on the national scale" = va_mean("REG"),
  "Eighth-grade GPA left out"              = va_mean("NOGPA"),
  "Parent questionnaire left out"          = va_mean("NOPAR"),
  "Eighth-grade SIMCE scores only"         = va_mean("SPL"),
  "Schools with 30 or more graduates"      = va_mean("HEAD", min_students = 30),
  "Class of 2013 only"                     = va_mean("C13"),
  "Class of 2015 only"                     = va_mean("C15"))
rbindlist(va_checks_list, idcol = "specification")

va_checks <- c("\\begin{tabular}{lrrr}", "\\toprule", " & Over-demanded & Other SAE & Difference \\\\", "\\midrule",
               unlist(lapply(names(va_checks_list), function(label) {
                 g <- va_checks_list[[label]]
                 c(row_tex(label, sd3(c(g$mean, g$mean[1] - g$mean[2]))),
                   paste0(" & & & (", sprintf("%.3f", sqrt(g$se[1]^2 + g$se[2]^2)), ") \\\\"))
               })),
               "\\bottomrule", "\\end{tabular}")
write_tex(va_checks, "lottery_od_historical_va_checks.tex")

# Appendix Table B.1 prints the macros written below
write_tex(c("\\begin{tabular}{lrr}", "\\toprule",
            " & \\makecell{Over-demanded\\\\schools} & \\makecell{Other SAE\\\\schools} \\\\", "\\midrule",
            "Schools in the historical catalog & \\SAEHistoricalODEligible{} & \\SAEHistoricalOtherEligible{} \\\\",
            "Schools in the estimation sample & \\SAEValueAddedODSchools{} & \\SAEValueAddedOtherSchools{} \\\\",
            "Graduates in the estimation sample & \\SAEValueAddedODStudents{} & \\SAEValueAddedOtherStudents{} \\\\",
            "\\bottomrule", "\\end{tabular}"),
          "lottery_od_historical_va_coverage.tex")
```

```{r historical-macros}
write_tex(c(sprintf("\\newcommand{\\SAEHistorical%s}{%s}", names(historical), historical),
            sprintf("\\newcommand{\\SAEValueAdded%s}{%s}", names(value_added), value_added)),
```

# Table II: effects on the entering class

```{r table2}
set.seed(SEED_MAIN)
g_reg <- fit_cs(CP, "gpa_z")
p_reg <- fit_cs(CP, "sh_prio")
z_g <- ri_test(CP, "gpa_z", "headline")
z_p <- ri_test(CP, "sh_prio", "headline")

headline <- data.table(outcome = names(outcomes), att = c(g_reg$att, p_reg$att), se = c(g_reg$se, p_reg$se),
                       p_ri = c(z_g$p, z_p$p), pre_mean = c(pre_mean(CP, "gpa_z"), pre_mean(CP, "sh_prio")),
                       obs = c(g_reg$n, p_reg$n))
headline
```

```{r table2-tex}

  "                   & (1) & (2)\\\\",

         ", the years the estimates use.}"),
  "\\end{table}", "")
write_tex(tab, "alloc_headline.tex")
```

# Figure 2: event studies

did's estimates by year relative to adoption, from $g-6$ to $g+1$, with pointwise 95% intervals, and the joint
randomization test of the five leads.

```{r figure2}
ES_TABLE_E <- c(-6:-2, 0:1)   # the reference g-1 has no estimate
set.seed(SEED_MAIN)
es_gpa <- fit_cs(CP, "gpa_z", "dynamic")[e %in% ES_TABLE_E]
set.seed(SEED_PRIO_ES)
es_prio <- fit_cs(CP, "sh_prio", "dynamic")[e %in% ES_TABLE_E]

es_plot <- function(es, ylab, file) {
  lo <- es$att - 1.96 * es$se; hi <- es$att + 1.96 * es$se
  pdf(file.path(FIG_DIR, file), width = 7.2, height = 4.8, family = "serif")
  par(mar = c(4.6, 5.0, 1.2, 1.2), las = 1, mgp = c(3.1, 0.8, 0), cex.axis = 1.05, cex.lab = 1.2)
  plot(es$e, es$att, type = "n", ylim = range(pretty(c(lo, hi))), xlim = c(min(es$e) - 0.4, max(es$e) + 0.4),
       xlab = "Event time (years relative to SAE adoption)", ylab = ylab, xaxt = "n")
  axis(1, at = min(es$e):max(es$e))
  abline(h = 0, col = "black", lwd = 1)
  abline(v = -0.5, col = "black", lty = 2)
  arrows(es$e, lo, es$e, hi, length = 0.045, angle = 90, code = 3, col = "black", lwd = 1.3)
  points(es$e, es$att, pch = 21, bg = "white", col = "black", cex = 1.25, lwd = 1.4)
  points(-1, 0, pch = 21, bg = "white", col = "black", cex = 1.25, lwd = 1.4)   # the reference class
  invisible(dev.off())
}
es_plot(es_gpa, "Effect on entrant prior-GPA (SD)", "alloc_event_study.pdf")
es_plot(es_prio, "Effect on low-income share", "alloc_event_study_prio.pdf")
```

```{r figure2-leads}
# The paired leads at g-6 .. g-2 under a rollout: for each adoption group g, the treated cells' mean change from
# g-1 to g+e less the not-yet-treated cells', averaged over the groups by their treated-cell counts
paired_leads <- function(pp, wv, leads = -6:-2) {
  G <- wv[as.character(pp$region)] + (1L - pp$is_entry) + 1L
  yrs <- pp$yrs; M <- pp$M
  out <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(leads)), leads)
  for (e in leads) {
    num <- 0; den <- 0
    for (g in sort(unique(G))) {
      bi <- match(g - 1L, yrs); ti <- match(g + e, yrs)
      if (is.na(bi) || is.na(ti)) next
      tr <- G == g
      ok_t <- tr & !is.na(M[, ti]) & !is.na(M[, bi])
      ok_c <- (G > g - 1L) & !tr & !is.na(M[, ti]) & !is.na(M[, bi])
      if (!any(ok_t) || !any(ok_c)) next
      att <- mean(M[ok_t, ti] - M[ok_t, bi]) - mean(M[ok_c, ti] - M[ok_c, bi])
      num <- num + sum(ok_t) * att; den <- den + sum(ok_t)
    }
    out[as.character(e)] <- if (den > 0) num / den else NA_real_
  }
  out
}

# count / total with two decimals, from the whole numbers (a tie goes to the even digit on every computer)
p_count <- function(count, total) {
  h <- (100 * count) %/% total
  r <- (100 * count) %% total
  sprintf("%.2f", (h + (2 * r > total | (2 * r == total & h %% 2 == 1))) / 100)
}

# The joint test of the five leads: each lead over its SD across the saved reassignments; the statistic is the
# largest of the five in absolute value
ri_pretrend_y <- function(D, yvar) {
  wv <- wave_map(D); pp <- prep_ri(D, yvar)
  obs <- paired_leads(pp, wv)
  P <- do.call(rbind, parLapply(cl, draws[[paste0("pretrends_", yvar)]], paired_leads, pp = pp))
  sdp <- apply(P, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  fmax <- apply(abs(P) / rep(sdp, each = nrow(P)), 1, max, na.rm = TRUE)
  p_count(1 + sum(fmax >= max(abs(obs) / sdp, na.rm = TRUE)), 1 + length(fmax))
}
es_p <- c(ri_pretrend_y(CP, "gpa_z"), ri_pretrend_y(CP, "sh_prio"))
es_p
```

# Appendix Table B.3: checks on the change in entrant composition

Rows 2-6 estimate both effects under five other specifications, each with 999 bootstrap draws and its own
saved reassignments.

```{r table-b3}
# Rows 1-6 of one column. Row 1 reports Table II's estimate and test; it is fitted here too, with 999 draws,
# because rows 2-6 continue its stream of bootstrap draws. a: did's anticipation (1 sets the base period to g-2)
robustness <- function(y, min5, key, main_fit, main_test) {
  specs <- list(
    list(lab = "Main estimate",               D = CP,                      w = NULL,    a = 0L),
    list(lab = "Metropolitan Region dropped", D = CP[region != 13L],       w = NULL,    a = 0L),
    list(lab = "Minimum of five entrants",    D = CP[get(min5) >= 5L],     w = NULL,    a = 0L),
    list(lab = "Pre-SAE demand restriction",  D = CP[slack_fail == FALSE], w = NULL,    a = 0L),
    list(lab = "Entrant-weighted",            D = CP,                      w = "w_ent", a = 0L),
    list(lab = "Reference period $g-2$",      D = CP,                      w = NULL,    a = 1L))
  set.seed(SEED_ROBUST)
  fits <- lapply(specs, function(s) fit_cs(s$D, y, bit = B_BOOT_ROBUST, w = s$w, anticipation = s$a))
  tests <- lapply(2:6, function(i) ri_test(specs[[i]]$D, y, paste0(key, i), specs[[i]]$w, specs[[i]]$a))
  fits[[1]] <- main_fit
  tests <- c(list(main_test), tests)
  data.table(label = vapply(specs, `[[`, "", "lab"), att = vapply(fits, `[[`, 0, "att"),
             se = vapply(fits, `[[`, 0, "se"), p_ri = vapply(tests, `[[`, 0, "p"), th = vapply(tests, `[[`, 0, "th"))
}
gpa_robustness <- robustness("gpa_z", "n_gpa", "gpa_robustness_", g_reg, z_g)
prio_robustness <- robustness("sh_prio", "n_ent", "prioritario_robustness_", p_reg, z_p)
```

Under a reassigned rollout the restricted sample changes: an entrant counts when her year comes no later than
the first year SAE covers a region and grade group of her prior records. `SIGNATURE` lists those, as in
`"15:0|4:1"`: region 15 outside the entry grades and region 4 in an entry grade.

```{r table-b3-prior-grades-test}
# the entrants with a prior-year GPA, summed by cell-year and signature
cells <- unique(CP[cod_nivel >= 2L, .(rbd, cod_nivel, region, is_entry)])
setkey(cells, rbd, cod_nivel)
cells[, cell_id := .I]
years <- sort(unique(CP$yr))
comp <- late[EXPOSURE_KNOWN == TRUE, .(n = .N, sum_z = sum(PRIOR_GPA_Z), sum_prio = sum(PRIO)),
             keyby = .(rbd = RBD, cod_nivel = COD_NIVEL, yr = AGNO, signature = SIGNATURE)]
comp[cells, on = .(rbd, cod_nivel), cell_id := i.cell_id]
rm(EP, late)

# each signature's regions and entry-grade status
sig <- data.table(signature = unique(comp$signature))
sig[, sig_id := .I]
mem <- sig[, tstrsplit(strsplit(signature, "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]], ":", fixed = TRUE), by = sig_id]
setnames(mem, c("sig_id", "region", "is_entry"))

context <- list(
  values = as.matrix(comp[, .(n, sum_z, sum_prio)]), yr = comp$yr,
  index = comp$cell_id + (match(comp$yr, years) - 1L) * nrow(cells),   # place in the cell x year matrix
  sig_id = sig[comp, on = "signature", sig_id],
  mem_sig = mem$sig_id, mem_region = mem$region, mem_offset = 2L - as.integer(mem$is_entry),
  region_index = match(cells$region, sort(unique(cells$region))), is_entry = cells$is_entry, years = years)

# the restricted outcomes under a rollout, as cell x year matrices
rebuild_exposure_outcomes <- function(context, waves) {
  first <- tapply(waves[context$mem_region] + context$mem_offset, context$mem_sig, min)   # by signature
  eligible <- context$yr <= first[context$sig_id]
  sums <- rowsum(context$values[eligible, , drop = FALSE], context$index[eligible], reorder = FALSE)
  at <- as.integer(rownames(sums))
  M <- matrix(NA_real_, length(context$is_entry), length(context$years))
  list(gpa_z = replace(M, at, sums[, "sum_z"] / sums[, "n"]),
       sh_prio = replace(M, at, sums[, "sum_prio"] / sums[, "n"]))
}

# the statistic of score_jackknife for an outcome matrix that changes with the rollout: every delete-one-region
# estimate comes from the regions' sums, in one pass
jackknife_fast <- function(data, adoption, years, region_index) {
  n_regions <- max(region_index)
  numerator <- denominator <- numeric(n_regions + 1L)
  for (g in sort(unique(adoption))) {
    baseline <- match(g - 1L, years)
    if (is.na(baseline)) next
    for (t in years[years >= g]) {
      difference <- data[, match(t, years)] - data[, baseline]
      ok <- !is.na(difference)
      treated <- ok & adoption == g
      control <- ok & adoption > t
      if (!any(treated) || !any(control)) next
      counts_t <- tabulate(region_index[treated], nbins = n_regions)
      counts_c <- tabulate(region_index[control], nbins = n_regions)
      sums <- matrix(0, nrow = n_regions, ncol = 2L)
      st <- rowsum(difference[treated], region_index[treated], reorder = FALSE)
      sc <- rowsum(difference[control], region_index[control], reorder = FALSE)
      sums[as.integer(rownames(st)), 1L] <- st[, 1L]
      sums[as.integer(rownames(sc)), 2L] <- sc[, 1L]
      nt <- sum(counts_t) - c(0L, counts_t)   # every region, then each region left out
      nc <- sum(counts_c) - c(0L, counts_c)
      sum_t <- sum(sums[, 1L]) - c(0, sums[, 1L])
      sum_c <- sum(sums[, 2L]) - c(0, sums[, 2L])
      valid <- nt > 0L & nc > 0L
      numerator[valid] <- numerator[valid] + sum_t[valid] - nt[valid] * sum_c[valid] / nc[valid]
      denominator[valid] <- denominator[valid] + nt[valid]
    }
  }
  estimates <- rep(NA_real_, n_regions + 1L)
  estimates[denominator > 0] <- numerator[denominator > 0] / denominator[denominator > 0]
  loo <- estimates[-1L]
  ok <- !is.na(loo); Rp <- sum(ok)
  variance <- if (Rp >= 2L) (Rp - 1) / Rp * sum((loo[ok] - mean(loo[ok]))^2) else NA_real_
  c(th = estimates[1L], t = estimates[1L] / sqrt(variance))
}

# both outcomes' statistics under one rollout
score_exposure_map <- function(waves, context) {
  M <- rebuild_exposure_outcomes(context, waves)
  adoption <- unname(waves)[context$region_index] + 2L - context$is_entry
  c(gpa_z = jackknife_fast(M$gpa_z, adoption, context$years, context$region_index),
    sh_prio = jackknife_fast(M$sh_prio, adoption, context$years, context$region_index))
}

clusterExport(cl, c("rebuild_exposure_outcomes", "jackknife_fast"), envir = environment())
observed <- score_exposure_map(wave_map(CP), context)
results <- do.call(rbind, parLapply(cl, draws$prior_gpa, score_exposure_map, context = context))

  att = c(r_gpa$att, r_prio$att), se = c(r_gpa$se, r_prio$se),
  p_ri = c(ri_p(observed[["gpa_z.t"]], results[, "gpa_z.t"]), ri_p(observed[["sh_prio.t"]], results[, "sh_prio.t"])),
  th = observed[c("gpa_z.th", "sh_prio.th")])
```
